goals.objective: Execute .omo/plans/start-flow-refactor-wave.md completely: conservative start-flow refactor for Next Move Report MVP, no intentional product behavior changes, preserve /start prefill/source tracking, free verdict, USD 9 Stripe paywall, paid/free checkout, resume recovery, invitation and modal behavior. Add RED->GREEN guards, implement all 8 planned tasks, keep start-flow files under the plan LOC caps, and collect CLI/browser evidence for each acceptance criterion. Do not commit automatically unless the user asks after implementation.

successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Capture a failing RED run after adding start-flow LOC/source guards, then a final passing GREEN run showing npm run verify:stability, npm test, npm run build, and targeted eslint succeed after all refactor tasks.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: RED .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-task-1-red.txt; GREEN .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-stability.txt, .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-regression.txt, .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-eslint.txt, .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-build.txt, .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-loc-audit.txt, .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-diff-check.txt. cleanup: closed reviewer agents; .omo/evidence/start-flow-refactor-final-port-check.txt shows no listener on tcp:3100
successCriteria.notes: Start-flow LOC guards pass; npm run verify:stability, npm test, targeted eslint, and npm run build passed after final refactor.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser happy path: Next Move start to 9 dollar paywall

successCriteria.notes: Browser happy path preserved /start reset context love, entry next_move_report_mvp_v1, Korean prefilled question, free verdict path, and Next Move Report Full Report .00 paywall.

successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Playwright evidence that Stripe price mismatch keeps checkout disabled with the Korean paused label, paid checkout still posts saved reading context, free promo avoids Stripe checkout, and resume/reset recovery still works.
